projects.usage: 适合想用 AI 提升效率的开发者，或者想快速搭建智能应用的创业者

projects.title: OpSafari / hypoarena
projects.description: Scientific hypothesis-discovery workbench: grounded hypothesis-evidence graphs, synthetic literature with planted causal chains, generate-debate-evolve loops over pluggable offline adapters, Elo tournaments recovering planted skill order, paraphrase dedup, Bayesian evidence accumulation, reproducible reports. NumPy core, CPU-only torch extra.
